simple.summary: עֲדַף (ʻădaph) means to be (causatively have ) redundant First listed occurrence: Exod 16 18.

definitions.usage: be more, odd number, be (have) over (and above), overplus, remain.
definitions.full: H5736. adaph [ עָדַף ] verb remain over, be in excess , synonym of סרח q. v., only P H (Late Hebrew id. , Aramaic עָדִיף superior (to); Arabic be profuse , IV. let down veil, or curtain, etc.; plentifulness ); — Qal Participle הָעֹדֵף סֶרַח Exod 26:12 the surplus (of curtains) that remains over , so feminine הָעֹדֶ֫פֶת 26:12 , and הָעֹדֵף as substantive 26:13 the excess in ( ב ) length; הָעֹדֵף = the surplus of food 16:23 , of price of field Lev 25:27 ; עַלֿ הָעֹדְפִים those over and above , Num 3:46 , 49 , compare 3:48 (no עַלֿ ). Hiph`il Perfect 3masculine singular הֶעְדִּיף Exod 16:18 have a surplus (of manna; opposed to הֶחְסִיר ).
